name: d3-manybody-wasm
description: WebAssembly C++ implementation of D3's many-body, X and Y forces

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && emcc --bind -o dist/d3-manybody-wasm.js src/cpp/force_many_body_legacy.cpp src/cpp/force_xy.cpp src/cpp/force_collide.cpp src/cpp/force_link.cpp -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s USE_ES6_IMPORT_META=1 -s ENVIRONMENT='web,worker,node' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=67108864 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["HEAPF32","HEAPF64"]' -msimd128 -O3 -flto
scripts.build:debug: mkdir -p dist && emcc --bind -o dist/d3-manybody-wasm-debug.js src/cpp/force_many_body_legacy.cpp src/cpp/force_xy.cpp src/cpp/force_collide.cpp src/cpp/force_link.cpp -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s USE_ES6_IMPORT_META=1 -s ENVIRONMENT='web,worker,node' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s INITIAL_MEMORY=67108864 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["HEAPF32","HEAPF64"]' -msimd128 -O0 -g4

author: matoototo
